name: Sins of a Solar Empire: Rebellion

achievements.name: Ensign
achievements.description: Win the game as a TEC player.

achievements.name: Acolyte
achievements.description: Win the game as an Advent player.

achievements.name: Initiate
achievements.description: Win the game as a Vasari player.

achievements.name: Master of Any Domain
achievements.description: Win the game as a Random player.

achievements.name: Plug Puller
achievements.description: Win the game by yourself against at least one Hard AI player.

achievements.name: Toaster Roaster
achievements.description: Win the game by yourself against at least two Hard AI players.

achievements.name: Comp Stomper
achievements.description: Win the game by yourself against at least three Hard AI players.

achievements.name: Actually HAL, I can do that.
achievements.description: Win the game by yourself against at least four Hard AI players.

achievements.name: Fear of Icebergs
achievements.description: Win the game without building any Capital Ships.

achievements.name: No Exhaust Port Found
achievements.description: Win the game without building any strike craft.

achievements.name: Best Defense is a Good Offense
achievements.description: Win the game without building any Tactical Structures.

achievements.name: Go Big or Go Home
achievements.description: Win the game without building any Frigates, Cruisers or Corvettes. You will probably need Capital Ships for this! (Not achievable with Quick Start.)

achievements.name: TEC Military Researcher
achievements.description: Research every subject in the Military Tree while researching no subjects in the Civilian, Defense or Diplomacy Trees.

achievements.name: Advent Hostility Researcher
achievements.description: Research every subject in the Hostility Tree while researching no subjects in the Harmony, Security, or Understanding Trees.

achievements.name: Vasari Warfare Researcher
achievements.description: Research every subject in the Warfare Tree while researching no subjects in the Empire, Fortification or Manipulation Trees.

achievements.name: TEC Civilian Researcher
achievements.description: Research every subject in the Civilian Tree while researching no subjects in the Military, Defense or Diplomacy trees.

achievements.name: Advent Harmony Researcher
achievements.description: Research every subject in the Harmony Tree while researching no subjects in the Hostility, Security or Understanding Trees.

achievements.name: Vasari Empire Researcher
achievements.description: Research every subject in the Empire Tree while researching no subjects in the Warfare, Fortification or Manipulation Trees.

achievements.name: Archaeologist
achievements.description: Find and own every artifact at the same time.

achievements.name: TEC Fleet Diversification
achievements.description: Have at least one of every TEC Capital Ship built at the same time.

achievements.name: Advent Fleet Diversification
achievements.description: Have at least one of every Advent Capital Ship built at the same time.

achievements.name: Vasari Fleet Diversification
achievements.description: Have at least one of every Vasari Capital Ship built at the same time.

achievements.name: Capital Ship Captain
achievements.description: Get a Capital Ship to maximum experience level.

achievements.name: Squadron Leader
achievements.description: Own at least 100 Squadrons at once.

achievements.name: Capital Ship Armada
achievements.description: Own the maximum number of Capital Ships possible. Your fleet research must also be max level.

achievements.name: Ship Swarm
achievements.description: Own the maximum number of ships your fleet points can support. Your fleet research must also be at max level.

achievements.name: Outstanding Resume
achievements.description: Complete at least 30 missions in a single game.

achievements.name: Star Explorer
achievements.description: Travel to another star system.

achievements.name: Escape From Max
achievements.description: Travel through a wormhole to discover where it leads to.

achievements.name: Money Lender
achievements.description: Give 25,000 Credits to other players in a single game.

achievements.name: Metal Lender
achievements.description: Give 20,000 Metal to other players in a single game.

achievements.name: Crystal Lender
achievements.description: Give 20,000 Crystal to other players in a single game.

achievements.name: Road to Peace
achievements.description: Form a Cease Fire with another player.

achievements.name: Pacifist
achievements.description: Form a Peace Treaty with another player.

achievements.name: Mutual Trader
achievements.description: Form a Trade Alliance with another player.

achievements.name: Planet Visionary
achievements.description: Form a Planet Vision alliance with another player.

achievements.name: Ship Visionary
achievements.description: Form a Ship Vision alliance with another player.

achievements.name: Family Planning
achievements.description: Your empire must support at least 6,000 population at once.

achievements.name: Tax Collector
achievements.description: Collect 200,000 Credits from taxes in a single game.

achievements.name: Export Maven
achievements.description: Collect 20,000 Credits from trade ships in a single game.

achievements.name: Metal Miner

achievements.name: Crystal Miner

achievements.name: Refining Magnate

achievements.name: Pop Idol
achievements.description: Spread your Culture to 75% of the galaxy.

achievements.name: Expert Bombardier

achievements.name: Frigate Killer

achievements.name: Capital Ship Assassin

achievements.name: Wrecking Crew

achievements.name: Pilot's Bane

achievements.name: Pirate Exterminator

achievements.name: Anti-Globalization

achievements.name: Dead Canaries

achievements.name: Union Buster

achievements.name: Space Ponies!
achievements.description: Um...What?

achievements.name: Colonizer

achievements.name: Crystal Speculator

achievements.name: Vacation Getaway

achievements.name: Destroyer of Worlds

achievements.name: Intrepid Explorer
